title: BlutufyWaypoint
body:
BlutufyWaypoint is a lightweight waypoint mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).

Mark locations across your worlds and servers, and always find your way back.

## Features
- Add, edit, enable/disable and delete waypoints from a clean in-game menu
- Waypoints are saved per world and per server — no mix-ups between different saves
- HUD overlay shows nearby waypoints at the top of your screen, positioned based on your looking direction
- Automatic death point — your last death location is saved so you never lose your items
- Dimension support — waypoints are filtered by dimension (Overworld, Nether, End)
- Keybinds to open the waypoint menu and add a waypoint at your current position (rebindable in Controls)
